x-k-k1-01.title: Ndeipi chiratidzo chinotungamirira kupaki yemotokari?
x-k-k1-01.goal: Verenga masaini matatu pfupi emugwagwa, batanidza mazwi nemubvi nechiratidzo chakatsanangurwa, uye utonge kuti ndeipi inotungamirira kunoita kuti muenzi aise motokari; dzivirira kutonga kwako pamberi pekuverenga kwakapera hafu kweshamwari.
x-k-k1-01.material:
"Muenzi anokwira kuchikoro ndokuda kusiya motokari kwehawa imwe. Masaini matatu ari kuonekwa (pasina mifananidzo, saka akatsanangurwa nemashoko).

Sign A: mavara machena '주차 금지' pabhodhi dzvuku. Denderedzwa dzvuku rine mutsetse wakatsemuka rinoyambuka mufananidzo mudiki wemotokari. Rakasungirirwa kuuzivi hwechikoro.
Sign B: bhodhi dzvuku bhuruu, mavara machena '방문자 주차장' nemubvi unotarisa kurudyi. Umire padivi pemugwagwa.
Sign C: bhodhi girini, mavara machena '주차장 출구' nemubvi unotarisa kumashure kumugwagwa. Rakarembera pamusoro penzira dzakamanikana apo motokari dzinobuda.

Mazwi: 주차(장) = parking (lot); 방문자 = visitor; 입구 = entrance; 출구 = exit."

x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Rondedzera zvinotaurwa nesaini imwe neimwe nemashoko, nezvinowedzerwa nechiratidzo chayo kana mubvi.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza pasaini yega yega: inotuma motokari mukati, kunze, kana kunhengo isipo?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.a: 주차장 iri musaini iyi, asi izwi rimwe chete pamaviri. Tarisa zvinotaurwa neizwi rechipiri nemubvi nezvenzira yainotora motokari.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.b: Saini iyi ine 주차 zvakare. Tarisa denderedzwa dzvuku rine mutsetse: chiratidzo chakadaro chinowanzokuudza chii?
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.c: Wakabatanidza izwi remuenzi, izwi rekupaka nemubvi. Ndiyo nzira inoverengwa nayo saini yose.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.o.d: Saini B kana Saini C; zvose zvinoti 주차장 uye zvine mubvi
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.r.d: Zvose zvinoti 주차장 uye zvine mubvi, asi tarisa zvinotaurwa neizwi rimwe reSaini C nenzira yemubvi wayo.
x-k-k1-01.s.s1.explain: Saini B ndeyevaenzi, inotumidza paki yemotokari uye inopa nzira. Saini A ine izwi rekutanga rimwe chete asi ine chiratidzo chekurambidza. Saini C inotumidzawo paki yemotokari, asi 출구 zvinoreva kubuda, saka inoratidza pakubuda motokari.
x-k-k1-01.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari inoti: 'Sign C has 주차장 in it, so let's drive in through there.' Pindura shamwari yako mumitsara mumwe kana miviri yechiRungu, uchishandisa zvinotaurwa chaizvo nesaini.

x-k-k1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura kuti saini yeiko (kubuda) uye chii chatinoda panzvimbo yacho here?

x-k-k1-08.title: 'Shoes off' ndeyepi nzvimbo?
x-k-k1-08.goal: Batanidza chiratidzo chimwe nenzvimbo yaichingodzvanyirirwa, uchishandisa zvidimbu zvechiitiko chimwe nechimwe, uye cherekedza zvisingataurwi nechiratidzo.
x-k-k1-08.material:
Chiratidzo chinoti: 신발을 벗고 들어오세요.

Mazwi: 신발 = shangu; 벗다 = kubvisa; 들어오세요 = ndapota pinda.

Nzvimbo nhatu, dzakatsanangurwa nemazwi:
Nzvimbo 1: shopu yeshangu. Vatengi vanoedza shangu uye vanofamba pakapeti yakatetepa.
Nzvimbo 2: restaurant diki. Nzvimbo yekudyira idhizaina rehuni rakakwidziridzwa ine matafura mahwihwi. Pamusuo mutsetse weshangu uri pamatombo.
Nzvimbo 3: jimu yechikoro. Dhizaina rehuni rakacheneswa nezuro. Vadzidzi vanopfeka shangu dzemukati dzakachena ipapo.

x-k-k1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa zvidimbu zvedhizaina nezvinopfekwa pamakumbo panzvimbo imwe neimwe.
x-k-k1-08.s.s1.r.a: Wakaona kuti vatengi vanoda shangu dzakapfekwa kana dzabviswa kuti vaedze mapeya; enzanisa nechiratidzo che 'thin carpet'.

x-k-k1-08.s.s1.explain: Restaurant ine zviratidzo zvakajeka zvikuru (dhizaina rakakwidziridzwa, shangu pamatombo). Jimu hairi yakakodzera zvakanyanya nokuti vadzidzi vatopfeka shangu dzemukati dzakachena, uye shopu yeshangu ndiyo isingakodzeri zvikuru nokuti vatengi vanoedza shangu.

x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.a: Wakaona kuti chiratidzo chinoti dzibvise, asi hachitauri kwekudzisiya.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.b: 들어오세요 inopindura izvi; chiratidzo chinokuudza kuti upinde.
x-k-k1-08.s.s2.r.c: Wakacherekedza kuti chiratidzo hachitauri chinhu pamusoro pemasokisi.
